tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rngog lo chen po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so/

/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog skad grags yod pa'i lo tsā ba zhig ste/ bod kyi rab byung dang po'i sa phag spyi lo ( 1059 ) lor yab chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po rngog chen po'i rgyud pa yar 'brog do'i phyi rol glo bo zhes pa'i mtsho 'gram du gnas gzhis chags pa snga 'gyur rnying ma pa'i dge bshes rdo rje gzhon nu la sras legs pa'i shes rab dang*/ klu khri/ klu byang*/ chos skyabs/ thub pa bcas lnga yod pa'i nang nas bzhi pa chos skyabs dang*/ yum dpal mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ sku na chung ngu'i dus su 'tsho gos cha rkyen zhan pa'i dbang gis sku ngal chen po byung*/ dgung lo bcu bdun par khyim nas khu bo legs pa'i shes rab kyi drung du bros byol gyis phebs skabs/ na bza' hrul po la dres ma'i sku chings 'khor tsam zhig las med/ bros pa'i lam bar du rtsam pa chu 'thag byed mi rnams la slong mo byas pas yos cung zad byung ba rnams rum du blugs/ gsang mdar byon te gnas tshang ma rnyed par khyim tshang zhig gi rta rwa'i nang du gzims te bzhugs skabs/ khu bo legs pa'i shes rab kyi gzim lam du khyim tshang de'i rta rwa'i nang du seng ge gser gyi mdog can zhig yod pa'i mtshan ma byung ste btsal bas/ tsha bo blo ldan shes rab yin pa shes nas mdun du bos te phyag 'tshol gsungs pas/ phyag 'tshal tshul slobs dang zhus pa bzhin bslabs te phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe/ dres ma'i sku rags chad nas yos rnams 'thor te de'i nye 'khor kun la khyab pas 'phrin las chen po yong ba'i rten 'brel du gzigs/ rig pa brtag phyir zho phor pa gang phye ma btab pa 'phyur ba zhig drangs pas mdun du zhog gsungs te/ gos kyi gong ba nas khab sbom zhig bton te phor pa'i kha mtha' nas dril te cung zad re 'gos pa rnams zos pas phor pa kha dma' ru song*/

rked pa nas rtsibs ma'i thur ma zhig bton te dkrugs dkrugs byas te ci bder gsol bas/ cung zad kyang phyi rol tu ma bo bar rig pa bzang bar khu bo ngo mtshar skyes/ khu bo dang gzus kyi slob ma sbos chung ba tshul khrims shes rab gnyis las rab tu byung nas mtshan blo ldan shes rab ces btags/ blo ldan dang shes rab gcig pa la ming gnyis brtsegs nas ci byed zhus par 'o na blo ldan bzang po gyis gsungs/ khong gi bstan bcos mang po'i mdzad byang la blo ldan bzang po zhes yod gsungs/ klog yig sngar nas mkhyen par khu bos sher phyin gyi 'grel pa don gsal mchan can zhig gtad nas de ring nags gseb pha gir 'di blo la zungs shig gsungs pas/ de'i dgong mor yi ge a ma rnams bzung yod bu chung tsho 'dzin dgos na sang nyin gzung chog ces gsungs/ nyin gcig la 'grel pa don gsal gyi mchan rnams ma gtogs thugs la zin pa'i rig stobs la khu bo legs pa'i shes rab ha las te khyod kyi slob dpon ngas mi yong gsungs nas rgya gar du mngags/ mdor na dgung lo bcu bdun par khu bo legs pa'i shes rab dang*/ gzus kyi slob ma sbos tshul khrims shes rab sogs kyi drung du lo gcig gi ring du slob gnyer mdzad de/ dgung lo bco brgyad par khu bos mthun rkyen gnang ste rgya gar du brdzangs pa ltar mnga' ris brgyud nas rgya gar du byon pa'i lam grogs su rgya gar du chos slob par phebs pa'i lo tsā ba btsan kha bo che/ khyung po chos brtson/ rwa lo tsā ba/ gnyan lo tsā ba rnams mnyam du byung*/ rgya gar yul dbus dang kha che bcas su lo bcu bdun ring mdo dang*/ sngags/ sgra rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa sogs la dka' spyad 'bad brtson blo yul du mi shong ba gnang nas sbyangs pa mthar phyin te/ dgung lo so lnga pa rab byung dang po'i chu sprel spyi lo ( 1092 ) lor bod du phyir phebs/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gdams ngag rnams sngon khu bo legs pa'i shes rab dang phyis mkhar phu ba las rdzogs par gsan/

gsang phu'i chos grwa'i gdan sa pa gnang ste tshad ma rnam nges dang kun btus/ byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma rigs tshogs dang rgyan snang bden gsum la sogs pa 'chad nyan mdzad/ chos gsung ba la shin tu mkhas pas chos thengs re gsungs dus nyan mkhan khri lhag dang nyung mthar stong phrag las mi nyung ba 'dus/ zur khrid kyi 'chad nyan byed thub pa'i slob ma rkyang pa yang chig stong brgyad brgya tsam yod zer/ khong ni mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun la nang byan chud pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin pa ma zad thugs rgyud kyang shin tu dul ba zhig ste/ gang gi zhal snga nas/ bai ro tsā na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ / ska cog rnam gnyis nyi zla zung dang mtshungs/ / rin chen bzang po tho rengs skar chen 'dra/ kho bo cag ni srin po me khyer tsam/ /zhes khengs skyung gnang*/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa rab byung gnyis pa'i sa mo glang ste spyi lo ( 1109 ) la sku gshegs/ de yang gshegs rkyen ni sngar slob dpon skal ldan rgyal po de dang po phyi pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs/ de rjes nang par zhugs pa zhig yin stabs nang pa'i dge slong la dud 'gro gsod pa ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa las med par go nas/ phyi pa'i lha thun mong gi dngos grub myur bas spangs ma nus par srog gi mchog sbyin byed kyi yod pa rngog los ma shes par/ bod du gdan zhu byas te phebs bsu'i ched bal por byon pa la| nyin gcig ra bsad nas mchod sbyin byed pa mthong ste/ de 'dra'i spyod ngan de bod la dar na bod kyi lta spyod gtsang ma 'di dag phung gis dogs nas khong gdan 'dren ma zhus par bod du phyir phebs pa la ma dga' nas/ khong gis rngog lo la gshin rje gshed kyi sbyin sreg byas/ lo 'ga'i rjes nas lo tsā ba 'phrin las shin tu che ba yod pas/ sbyin sreg nyer lngas 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang*/ lnga bcus sar gnas kyi sems chub dpa' yang gsod nus par bshad pa bzhin byas kyang ma thub par shes/

de nas slar yang brgya rtsa brgyad kyis dag pa sa yang sgrol nus par bshad pa bzhin byas te/ ri ya ma ri'i 'gram klu byang bying gsum gyi mtshams su sgug sdod ces 'phrin bskur/ der phebs pa na sku bsnyungs pas gaṇḍi rdungs gsungs pas gaṇa g.yog ma byung*/ dung bud gsungs pas rtsam pa dang 'brel bas zubs/ btsun chung zhig la gzhung zhig thon gsungs pas/ lha yis rgyal pos char phab kyang*/ / sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ / sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*/ / skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*/ / zhes pa sogs bton/ lo tsā ba'i thugs dgongs la mthu 'di bzlog thub kyang dam tshig gi sel du 'gro'o snyam nas/ lbu ba rdos 'dra rab tu 'jig pa'i lus 'di ni/ / ri mchog 'dra ba'i rang bzhin 'dis ni gtan nas bslus/ khyed kyang sde snod chos la sbyongs shig rig pa yis/ / chos nyid mthong ba'i tshad ma'i nges shes skye bar 'gyur/ / zhes thugs sras kyi thu bo zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma dang*/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas la gsungs te ma ri'i rtsar mya ngan las 'das/ spur shing rta la gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ sa g.yos/ 'ja' 'od dang sgra chen po byung*/ gsang mdar gdung sbyangs pas ston pa'i sku la sogs pa'i gdung rten khyad par can mang du byon/ khong la slob ma lha sa dang*/ bsam yas sogs su khri phrag mang po yod par gsungs pa las zur khrid byed thub pa chig stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga las/ rgyan dang chos mchog 'chad mkhan lnga bcu rtsa lnga tsam dang*/ rnam nges 'chad mkhan brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa lnga yod par gsungs pa las/ grags che ba ni/ zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma dang*/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ khyung rin chen grags/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ gangs pa she'u/ gong bu ra can/ sham po me dig / me lhang tsher/ dmar sgas lang*/ rngog skya bo/ tre bo mchog gi bla ma sogs yin/ khong gi bsgyur chos ni/

gro lung pas/ dam chos bsgyur la mnga' brnyes pas/ / rgyal yum gnyis dang bstan bcos gzhung*/ / 'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gsum/ / stong phrag bdun ni lhag bcas bsgyur/ / ces gsungs 'dug khong gi brtsams chos la/ 'grel chung don gsal/ shes rab snying po/ mdo sde rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ chos dbyings rnam 'byed/ dbu ma bden gnyis/ dbu ma rgyan/ spyod 'jugatshad ma rnam nges kyi 'grel pa/ chos mchog chung ba ste bcu gcig la rnam bshad re dang bsdus don re bcas gnyis re dang*/ brgyad stong 'grel pa dang*/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/ shes rab sgron me/ dbu ma snang ba/ bslab btus/ dbu ma'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa/ jo bo'i bden chung*/ dbu ma'i man ngagachos mchog gi tshad ma brtag pa chung ba/ de'i skad cig la 'jig pa grub pa bcu gcig la don bsdu re dang bstod 'grel re bcas gnyis re mdzad/ 'thad ldan che chung gnyis/ chos mchog chen po dang dbu ma'i tshigs bcad bdun gyi bshad pa/ gzhan sel gyi skabs kyi bshad pa rnams mdzad/ chos mchog gi sel ba grub pa dang*/ bram ze bde byed dga' ba'i sel ba grub pa/ 'grel pa grub pa gsum la don bsdus re dang bstod 'grel re bcas gnyis re mdzad/ dbu ma'i don bsdus pa dang*/ mnga' ris kyi btsan por gser slong ba'i spring yig dang*/ spring yig bdud rtsi'i theg le/ bstan rim/ bslab btus kyi 'grel pa dang*/ gzhan yang bka' bstan gyi dkar chag sogs du ma zhig mdzad yod par gsungs so/ / dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas/ - PAGE 4 --PAGE 3-- PAGE 1 -
